mechanism: Fluoxetine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing cenobamate concentrations; cenobamate induces CYP3A4, potentially decreasing fluoxetine effectiveness.
action: Monitor for reduced fluoxetine efficacy and cenobamate toxicity; consider fluoxetine dose adjustment or alternative antidepressant; baseline and periodic seizure control assessment recommended.
